units.text: We built a REST API for partners with OAuth sign-in and a public changelog, and partner calls ran at 99.8% uptime over 6 months.
I automated the 15 most used user flows as Playwright end-to-end tests and made any failing test block the release. Weekly releases have since run for 5 months without a rollback.
I set up a lunchtime book club for 12 colleagues and selected the book for each month.
